_comment: Seed S3 (SPEC/10 section 3.4, section 5; F10.5). Each case is a change to refagent's manifest, as this tree holds it with `callers: []` appended as its base, made with the Tool Owner's ruling alone in a copy of the tree (tests/test_m07_two_key_seed.py's pattern). From M10 PR 2 `two-key` must refuse each naming the path and ADR-0016 (entry 7 of the closed list), and pass the same diff with Security's second key. Today two_key.relaxations has no entry for `callers`, so every case passes with one key: the false state. `not_a_relaxation` cases are guards with a base of their own: a diff that narrows or first writes the field passes with one key today and must still pass after the reader (cold review F2 on PR 1: a byte-identical manifest is no guard, since two-key never sees it). The subject and issuer are made up.
